rows.note: Use this compact pattern before a countable noun when the classifier construction naturally carries the possessive meaning.
Use this zero-marker pattern especially with kinship, organizational, and other relational nouns such as 我父母.

example.jyutping: ngo5 fu6 mou5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
